purpose: Decide whether the completed control can serve as the unchanged predecessor after the additive mixed-evidence transport fix without reading semantic answers.
method: Use a separately registered model-free byte-only verifier over the finalized control request trace.
Stream each canonical MODEL_REQUEST in recorded order without logging message text or normalized model responses.
Render the exact same request object through the old and fixed LlamaServerTransport message renderer.
Record only request ordinal, request_id hash, old rendered-byte SHA-256, new rendered-byte SHA-256 and byte counts.
Require exactly 3000 requests, identical request ordering, equal byte counts and equal SHA-256 for every request.
Emit only aggregate counts and a create-only verification receipt; emit no prompts, transcripts, responses, predictions, scores or labels.
failure_rule: Any missing request or byte/hash difference makes existing control ineligible for the recovery comparison. Root must then stop and decide whether a separately authorized fresh control is scientifically required; this package does not authorize one.
retained_service_gate: Separately verify the prior and current session documents name the identical model/build/packet roots and c65536/np4/max256 geometry. Do not query the service for this byte-only check.
authorization: This template does not authorize opening the held trace. Root must register the exact byte-only check and its source/input hashes first.
